posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
I can finally join this preorder next week, but until then, I have to decide if I should back for Tactics or not. On the one hand, I've only managed to play the base set one time and I felt a little sad when I won by incapping both of my opponents characters at once thanks to Visionary Ether Twisting and Beacon's double hit + all ranges greater than needed double. It's quick and dirty by design, and I'd definitely like to try it out again, especially in a full three man team. Having a playable Matriarch would really pump up many people I know into trying it out sooner rather than later. We all love her design and flavour, even if we rarely if ever break out her villain deck. In reality, I fear that would be the prime and possibly only reason for ordering Broken City, though. I don't need more variety for a game I've pulled out all of once since getting it via KickStarter!

 

I may have to pass. Thanks, team, for this chance to stream my thoughts! Here's to hoping she'll make it into the card game, though it seems she might not and her heroic swap happens after the Sentinels arc.

posts.cooked: YMMV, obviously, but I would give Tactics another chance.  The depth of strategy for each character is really quite impressive.  I say this who had only gotten to play the production copy a handful of times before demoing at PAX South this weekend and seeing the different things that brand new folks to the game would try.

posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked: Also, Setback, The Hippo, Chairman Pike/Exemplar, and possible Miss Information! That's just awesome!

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
I fully intend on playing Tactics again! Several more times, if the table can finally agree to try something new. From my initial play, it seems like a decently light tactics game, the strengths coming out when there are full teams and multiple players, I feel. My one play was two players with two characters each, not much of any thought put into team building, either, beyond 'Visionary is my favourite character, I am bloody well going to play her now.' Was anyone else taken aback when she was never selected in the tournament? From playing her once and reading her cards, she seems like a great character to have around, both offensively and defensively. Anywho, that's neither here nor there.

 

I am terribly excited to see what kind of mischief The Great Hippocalypse can bring to the world of Tactics! It's very interesting seeing the transisition from card game to table top game, and that is the biggest factor in my wanting to pick everything up now, but my fear is simply the whole lot becoming little more than decoration.
